name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog
description: A confirmation in the dashboard's framed dialog: a title, a muted line, and Cancel beside the blue or red action over a light line.
usage: Ask before something that cannot be undone or costs money: revoking a key, deleting a monitor, changing a plan. Say what happens in the title (Revoke this key?) and the consequence in the description; name the action with its verb (Revoke key), never Yes or OK. Use variant destructive on the action when it removes something. Use size sm for a short yes-or-no with an icon in AlertDialogMedia.
avoid: A close glyph (the person answers it)
Yes and No as the action labels
